Overview

Kropyvnytskyi is a city in Kirovohrad with a population of 227,000. A city in central Ukraine, the administrative center of Kirovohrad Oblast and a historic Cossack settlement. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
